solution.title: Endpoint Network Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit (DNS, Proxy, VPN, IP/Port/URL Filtering)

products.name: Endpoint Network Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit (DNS, Proxy, VPN, IP/Port/URL Filtering) — Commercial
products.short_description: A vendor-neutral, endpoint-side root-cause method and scripts to isolate connectivity failures across DNS, proxy/PAC, VPN, and IP/Port/URL filtering — prove where the block is. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Isolate why the endpoint can't reach the service — layer by layer

“It works on my machine” hides a stack of possible causes: DNS, proxy/PAC, VPN, or an IP/Port/URL filter silently blocking the traffic. This vendor-neutral toolkit gives you a layered root-cause method and diagnostic scripts to test each layer from the endpoint — name resolution, proxy, VPN tunnel, and access-control filters — so you prove where the block is instead of guessing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the endpoint-to-service path (DNS → proxy/PAC → VPN → firewall/URL filter → service) and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (endpoint access, network/proxy details, test targets) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (name won't resolve, resolves-can't-connect, proxy/PAC misroute, VPN split-tunnel gap, IP:Port blocked, URL category blocked) with the exact checks per layer.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — connectivity/DNS/proxy discovery, per-endpoint reachability validation (name/IP/port/URL), a connectivity coverage report, safe local remediation (cache/route/proxy reset), and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the responsible layer, plus Best Practices for repeatable network triage and escalation with evidence.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The exact layer blocking the endpoint — DNS, proxy, VPN, or a filter — proven with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse on every connectivity incident.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NETDX-Discovery.ps1 — capture the endpoint's connectivity posture (DNS, proxy/PAC, VPN, routes)
    • NETDX-Remediation.ps1 — safe, local, reversible resets (DNS cache / route cache / stale proxy)
    • NETDX-Report.ps1 — roll validation results into a connectivity-coverage report
    • NETDX-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/maintain a pilot Entra group for staged connectivity testing
    • NETDX-Validation.ps1 — per-target reachability validation (name, IP, port, URL) from the endpoint

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
